    • Result

      private Result(String chainIdentifier, String manifestIdentifier, List<AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationS8StreamApplicationBatchReconciliationCheckpointManifestTransition.Result> transitions, String firstManifestDigestHex, String finalManifestDigestHex, int strictAppendTransitionCount, int unchangedTransitionCount, int addedReconciliationCount, int addedEntryCount, int addedStrictAppendCount, int addedUnchangedCount, byte[] chainDigest)
      Create an immutable transition-chain result.
      Parameters:
      chainIdentifier - caller-defined chain identity
      manifestIdentifier - shared manifest identity
      transitions - ordered transition receipts
      firstManifestDigestHex - first prior-manifest digest
      finalManifestDigestHex - final candidate-manifest digest
      strictAppendTransitionCount - strict-append transition count
      unchangedTransitionCount - unchanged transition count
      addedReconciliationCount - aggregate added reconciliation count
      addedEntryCount - aggregate added represented-entry count
      addedStrictAppendCount - aggregate added strict-append entry count
      addedUnchangedCount - aggregate added unchanged entry count
      chainDigest - canonical chain digest
